annotations.text:
Round 2 — cartoon.

The first four were academic and professional, which is the opposite of what the owner wants. These four are all playful and illustrated; what differs is HOW.

Same content in each. Ask the owner for a letter — and it's fine to mix, e.g. "E's character with F's colours".

E · MASCOT
An owl greets the student by name and speaks to them. Thick outlines, hard drop shadows, chunky buttons. Homework becomes "quests".

Strongest on: warmth, daily habit, a character the school can own and put on posters.
Trade-off: a mascot is a commitment — it needs drawing for every state, and a 17-year-old may find it babyish.

F · STICKER BOOK
Everything is a sticker: white keylines, hard shadows, slight tilts, confetti. Bold and loud, no character to maintain.

Strongest on: energy, cheap to extend — any new card is just another sticker.
Trade-off: the tilts can read as messy on a small screen, and lots of saturated colour at once tires the eye.

G · PUFFY
Soft 3D. Rounded, inflated shapes with gentle gradients and glow — toy-like rather than cartoon-drawn. No outlines anywhere.

Strongest on: modern and premium while still playful; the one direction that suits 8-year-olds AND 17-year-olds.
Trade-off: gradients and blur are the easiest thing to get wrong in Flutter and the most expensive to render on a cheap Android.

H · DOODLE
Notebook paper with the red margin line. Hand-drawn boxes, wobbly underlines, a to-do list with drawn checkboxes.

Strongest on: charming and genuinely different — nothing else in this market looks like it. Feels like a school.
Trade-off: the handwritten font has no Kurdish letterforms, so Sorani text would fall back to a plain font and break the effect. Fixable, but it is real work.

STILL WORTH DECIDING

These are drawn in English, left-to-right. The real app is Sorani Kurdish and reads RIGHT-TO-LEFT.

This matters most for H: handwriting fonts almost never cover Kurdish, so that one needs a font decision before it can be built.

Tell me the letter and I'll show it in Kurdish RTL before writing any Flutter.

Round 1, kept only for reference — the owner said these are too academic and professional.

Nothing here is being built. Flip back to "Cartoon directions" for the live set.
